fullPassage: While newborns do not seem to be stressed when their parents walk out of the room, infants around one year old often cry uncontrollably even if their parents are gone for just a short while. What changes occur between these stages? Object recognition and retention turn out to be the key. For the first couple of months of life, the cognitive abilities of babies are still developing, and their understanding that objects continue to exist even when they are out of sight has not yet formed. Newborns believe that the only things that exist are those they can see. Consequently, when their parents leave their view, they do not experience distress because they cannot fully grasp the significance of the absence of their parents —for them, out of sight means out of existence. However, as they grow, infants begin to be able to perceive objects and mentally represent them even when those objects are not directly visible. So the absence of their parents now takes on a new meaning; they are not where they are supposed to be. It is this awareness that triggers feelings of anxiety during the period of separation.

det.tip: perceive objects = 사물을 인지하다

questions.passage: While newborns do not seem to be stressed when their parents walk out of the room, infants around one year old often cry uncontrollably even if their parents are gone for just a short while. What changes occur between these stages? Object recognition and retention turn out to be the key. For the first couple of months of life, the cognitive abilities of babies are still developing, and their understanding that objects continue to exist even when they are out of sight has not yet formed. Newborns believe that the only things that exist are those they can see. Consequently, when their parents leave their view, they do not experience distress because they cannot fully grasp the significance of the absence of their parents —for them, out of sight means out of existence. However, as they <u>grow</u>, infants begin to be able to perceive objects and mentally represent them even when those objects are not directly visible. So the absence of their parents now takes on a new meaning; they are not where they are supposed to be. It is this awareness that triggers feelings of anxiety during the period of separation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 grow와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① arrive(도착하다)는 grow와 다른 의미축(이동)이라 반의어가 아님
❌ ② argue(주장하다)도 다른 의미축(의견)이라 반의어가 아님
❌ ③ measure(측정하다)도 무관한 의미축
✅ ④ decline(쇠퇴하다, 줄어들다)은 grow(자라다, 늘어나다)와 정확히 반대되는 의미 ←정답
det.tip: grow(성장하다) ↔ decline(쇠퇴하다) — un-/in- 같은 접두사 조작이 아닌 다른 어근의 진짜 반의어

det.analysis:

❌ ② importance(중요성)는 다른 의미축(가치)이라 반의어가 아님
❌ ③ silence(침묵)도 무관한 의미축

questions.passage:
(A) After several years of training, she <u>still</u> finds public speaking nerve-wracking. Even experienced speakers often feel nervous before a big presentation.

(B) The lake was perfectly <u>still</u> at dawn, without a single ripple on its surface. Not even a breeze disturbed the quiet morning.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에 쓰인 밑줄 친 still의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
(A)에서 still은 동사 finds 앞에 쓰인 부사로 '여전히'라는 뜻이며, 훈련을 여러 해 받았는데도 '여전히' 긴장한다는 의미이다.
(B)에서 still은 호수의 상태를 묘사하는 형용사로 '고요한, 움직임이 없는'이라는 뜻이며, 물결 하나 없이 조용한 새벽 호수를 묘사한다.
✅ ③ (A) 여전히 (B) 고요한 ←정답
나머지 선지는 두 의미를 뒤바꾸거나 무관한 뜻을 넣은 오답이다.
det.tip: still: 부사(여전히, 아직) vs 형용사(고요한, 정지된) — 문장에서의 위치와 품사로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to remember and keep information in the mind"

det.analysis:
❌ ① distraction(주의 산만)은 정의와 무관
✅ ② retention(보유력, 기억력)이 '정보를 기억하고 마음속에 유지하는 능력'이라는 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ exhibition(전시)은 무관
❌ ④ prevention(예방)도 무관
det.tip: retention = 기억력, 보유력 (본문의 Object recognition and retention 참고)

questions.passage: However, as they grow, infants begin to be able to perceive objects and mentally represent them even when those objects are not directly visible. So the absence of their parents now __________ (take) on a new meaning; they are not where they are supposed to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 3인칭 단수 주어(the absence)+현재시제 → take에 -s를 붙여 takes
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞의 주어는 the absence(단수 명사)이고 문장 전체가 현재시제(now)이므로, 동사원형 take에 3인칭 단수 현재형 어미 -s를 붙여 takes로 써야 한다. 'take on a new meaning'은 '새로운 의미를 띠다'라는 뜻의 표현이다.
det.tip: take → takes (주어가 3인칭 단수일 때 현재형에 -s)

questions.passage: For the first couple of months of life, the cognitive abilities of babies are still developing, and their understanding that objects continue to exist even when they are out of sight has not yet __________ (form).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: has not yet + 과거분사 (현재완료) → form을 과거분사 formed로
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 has not yet이 있어 현재완료(have/has + p.p.) 구조임을 알 수 있다. 따라서 동사원형 form을 과거분사 formed로 바꿔야 한다. 'has not yet formed'는 '아직 형성되지 않았다'라는 뜻이다.
det.tip: form → formed (has/have + p.p. 현재완료 구조)

det.analysis:
